fusions.name: Echo Sweep
fusions.desc: Sends a click 4 tiles ahead of you in a cone, dealing 3 damage to everything in it, with a 20% chance per hit to leave it [Marked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Night Swoop
fusions.desc: You swoop up to 6 tiles onto the target and bite for 14 damage, 10% more for each affliction on it (up to 30%), healing for 15% of the damage dealt and leaving it 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Erratic Flight
fusions.desc: You blink 2 tiles and your movement speed rises by 30% for 6 seconds. You have 10% more dodge chance.

fusions.name: Dark-Adjusted
fusions.desc: At night, you deal 10% more damage. You have 5% more dodge chance.
